title: The Dead Star That Can Erase Your Credit Cards
description: Discover magnetars, the universe's most powerful magnets, capable of affecting Earth from across the galaxy.

beats.text: A dead star halfway to the Moon could erase your credit cards.
beats.visual: artist's concept of a magnetar with powerful magnetic field lines, NASA, 2020

beats.text: This cosmic monster is a magnetar, an ultra-dense star only twenty kilometers wide.
beats.visual: size comparison illustration of a magnetar next to a major city

beats.text: It generates a magnetic field of one thousand trillion gauss, the strongest in the universe.
beats.visual: artist's concept of a neutron star showing intense magnetic field lines, NASA, 2013

beats.text: On December twenty-seventh, two thousand four, a starquake on one magnetar triggered a giant flare.
beats.visual: artist's concept of SGR 1806-20 giant flare, NASA, 2004

beats.text: In one-tenth of a second, the flare released more energy than our Sun emits in one hundred thousand years.
beats.visual: NASA artist concept of the powerful gamma ray burst in space, 2004
queries: Gamma ray burst hitting Earth atmosphere artist

beats.text: The blast traveled across the galaxy and briefly ionized and expanded Earth's upper atmosphere.
beats.visual: Earth's glowing upper atmosphere and aurora viewed from the International Space Station, 2015
